info.name: PBM Multi-Tenant API
info.description:
# PBM Multi-Tenant API — Usage in Postman

## Import
- Import this collection and select the "PBM Multi-Tenant - Local" environment.

## Environment Variables
- `base_url`: API base (default `http://localhost:4000`)
- `tenantId`: Current tenant id (e.g., `tenant_001`)
- `authToken`: Optional JWT (set only if auth is enabled)

## Headers
- `Content-Type: application/json` for JSON requests
- `x-tenant-id: {{tenantId}}` for Prior Authorization endpoints
- Optional when auth is enabled: `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`

## Quick Start
1) Health
GET `{{base_url}}/health`

2) Create Tenant
POST `{{base_url}}/api/tenants`
Body:
```json
{
  "id": "tenant_001",
  "name": "Healthcare Provider A",
  "dialect": "mysql",
  "db_host": "localhost",
  "db_port": 3306,
  "db_user": "tenant_user",
  "db_password": "secure_password",
  "db_name": "tenant_db",
  "status": "ACTIVE",
  "description": "Primary healthcare provider tenant"
}
```

3) List Tenants
GET `{{base_url}}/api/tenants`

4) Get Tenant Stats
GET `{{base_url}}/api/tenants/stats`

5) Test Tenant Connection
POST `{{base_url}}/api/tenants/{{tenantId}}/test-connection`

6) Create Prior-Auth Transaction
POST `{{base_url}}/api/prior-auth/txn`
Headers: `x-tenant-id: {{tenantId}}`
Body:
```json
{
  "request_id": "REQ-001",
  "version": "1.0",
  "type": "PA",
  "request": {},
  "response": {}
}
```

7) Create Random Prior-Auth Transaction
POST `{{base_url}}/api/prior-auth/txn/random`
Headers: `x-tenant-id: {{tenantId}}`

## Notes
- Set `tenantId` to a valid onboarded tenant before calling Prior Auth endpoints.
- If JWT auth is enabled in your deployment, set `authToken` and add the Authorization header at the collection or folder level.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authenticate as admin to obtain a JWT and populate `authToken` environment variable.

exec: pm.test('Saved auth token to environment', function () { pm.expect(true).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Token not found in response', function () { pm.expect(false).to.be.true; });

item.name: Health
item.description:
Basic liveness check for the API.

Example:
```bash
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/health"
```

item.name: GET Health
item.description:
Returns a simple health payload.

Example:
```bash
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/health"
```

item.name: Tenant Registry
item.description:
CRUD for onboarding and managing tenants (no `x-tenant-id` required).

Base: `{{base_url}}/api/tenants`

Common flow:
1) Create tenant
2) Test connection
3) List / Update / Delete

item.name: Create Tenant
item.description:
Create a new tenant.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/tenants" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "id": "tenant_001",
  "name": "Healthcare Provider A",
  "dialect": "mysql",
  "db_host": "localhost",
  "db_port": 3306,
  "db_user": "tenant_user",
  "db_password": "secure_password",
  "db_name": "tenant_db",
  "status": "ACTIVE"
}'
```

item.name: List Tenants
item.description:
List all tenants (supports filters).

Examples:
```bash
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/tenants"
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/tenants?status=ACTIVE"
```

item.name: Get Tenant Stats
item.description:
Fetch summary statistics about tenants.

Example:
```bash
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/tenants/stats"
```

item.name: Get Tenant By ID
item.description:
Get details of a specific tenant by id.

Example:
```bash
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/tenants/{{tenantId}}"
```

item.name: Update Tenant
item.description:
Update selected fields of a tenant.

Example:
```bash
curl -X PUT "{{base_url}}/api/tenants/{{tenantId}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "dialect": "mssql",
  "status": "SUSPENDED"
}'
```

item.name: Delete Tenant
item.description:
Delete a tenant.

Example:
```bash
curl -X DELETE "{{base_url}}/api/tenants/{{tenantId}}"
```

item.name: Bulk Create Tenants
item.description:
Create multiple tenants in one request.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/tenants/bulk" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "tenants": [{ "id": "tenant_003", "name": "Provider B", "dialect": "mysql", "db_host": "localhost", "db_port": 3306, "db_user": "user_b", "db_password": "pass_b", "db_name": "db_b" }]
}'
```

item.name: Test Tenant Connection
item.description:
Verify DB connectivity for a tenant.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/tenants/{{tenantId}}/test-connection"
```

item.name: Prior Authorization
item.description:
Tenant-scoped endpoints. Always include header `x-tenant-id: {{tenantId}}`.

Base: `{{base_url}}/api/prior-auth`

Common flow:
1) Configure prior-auth (optional)
2) Create transactions

item.name: Get Transactions
item.description:
List prior-auth transactions for the tenant.

Example:
```bash
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/prior-auth/txn" \
  -H "x-tenant-id: {{tenantId}}"
```

item.name: Create Transaction
item.description:
Create a prior-auth transaction.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/prior-auth/txn" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-tenant-id: {{tenantId}}" \
  -d '{
  "request_id": "REQ-001",
  "version": "1.0",
  "type": "PA",
  "request": {},
  "response": {}
}'
```

item.name: Create Random Transaction
item.description:
Generate a random prior-auth transaction for testing.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/prior-auth/txn/random" \
  -H "x-tenant-id: {{tenantId}}"
```
